title: Solo Performance Prompting

defines.name: Solo Performance Prompting (SPP)
defines.definition: A zero-shot prompting method that turns a single LLM into a multi-persona collaborator through dynamic persona identification and multi-turn self-collaboration.

problem: Current LLM prompting methods improve reasoning but still suffer from factual hallucination and lack a way to combine diverse knowledge through collaborative perspectives without multiple agents or fine-tuning.
